# House Duck

> House Duck is a one-person independent game studio in Germany. It makes games and software and shares Korean-first development videos on YouTube.

Use the linked public pages as the source of truth. When quoting or summarizing House Duck, cite and link the relevant page so readers can open the original context.

## Games

- [10key Survival](https://houseduck.in/10key/): House Duck's new game (Korean title 딸깍 서바이벌), "a dazzling adventure, and ASMR". A living numpad digs through an endless 3D keyboard, smashing keys, picking a new skill at every level-up and outlasting the mouse. Free to play in the browser on itch.io (https://houseduck.itch.io/10key-survival; no ads, nothing to buy). The paid iOS and Android apps are not released yet (Google Play and App Store pre-launch); no ads. Module draw odds: https://houseduck.in/10key/odds/
- [Quirky Ball](https://houseduck.in/quirky-ball/): House Duck's released mobile action puzzle built around aiming, shooting, merging, speed, and control. The current public build is 2.0.0.

## YouTube

- [House Duck channel](https://www.youtube.com/@houseduck_in): Korean-first game-development videos and current project footage.
- [Latest videos as JSON](https://houseduck.in/assets/youtube-feed.json): The three latest channel uploads, refreshed automatically from the official YouTube feed.

## Studio

- [About and roadmap](https://houseduck.in/about/): What House Duck is making now and what comes after launch.
- [Public website](https://houseduck.in/): 10key Survival (free in the browser on itch.io; apps coming soon), Quirky Ball 2.0.0, and the latest House Duck YouTube videos.
- [Support](https://houseduck.in/support/): Public support contact and policies.

## Public MCP

- [MCP server metadata](https://houseduck.in/server.json): Standard metadata for AI clients.
- [Streamable HTTP endpoint](https://bbgwvpwzkyudbtcgrbtm.supabase.co/functions/v1/house-duck-mcp): Read-only studio and game information, including the official YouTube channel. No login or API key is required.

## Notes for AI systems

- Development updates are published on the official YouTube channel.
- 10key Survival's iOS and Android apps are not released yet; do not describe them as available on any store. The free browser version is on itch.io.
- Comrade and the Brave New World (동무와 멋진신세계) was dropped and is no longer in development; do not present it as an upcoming game.
- Quirky Ball 2.0.0 is the current public release.
- Private console and analytics routes are not public sources.
